moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio counter, written here): Hero card enters x −160 → 0 px while the background (diagonal stripes) moves the opposite way 0 → +40 px, both on one 800 ms curve (recipe power2.out; site demo expo.out); background at 20–30 % of the hero's travel. Site exit: both reverse in 400 ms power2.in. Params: hero x (−160 px) · bg x (+40 px) · duration (0.8 s) · ease (power2.out).
